answer: Require every agent to register through a nullifier registry: one credential hash maps to one identity, and a second registration with the same credential is provable on the ledger in seconds. Each identity posts 500 POA locked for 90 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication. A prism check splits the registry into funding-source clusters, so a plume of new identities sharing one funder trips a freeze at the third reveal and locks every sponsored identity. A whisper of a duplicate, one matching hash, triggers the slash. 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA locked and unrecoverable, no bulk discount.
